name: Visas on arrival

activity.text_en: What is the main purpose of your visit?

labels_en.holiday_family_meetings_transit: Tourism, family visits, meetings, incentives, conventions, exhibitions or transit.

nationality.text_en: What is the nationality of your passport? Answer with its ISO 3166-1 two-letter country code (for example AU).

eligible_nationality.text_en: Has your nationality been confirmed as eligible for visa on arrival?

travel_status.text_en: Which travel status applies to you?

stay_days.text_en: How many days do you need to stay?

notes: Both codes allow one entry and an initial 30 DAY stay, with one extension to a total of 60 days. Owner ruling 2026-10-19: B1 is 30 days, not a 60-day initial product.
B4 requires a visa-on-arrival subject nationality but its card contains no country list. Eligibility must be confirmed from the official list; unknown answers ask again.

OWNER RULING 2026-10-19: B1 decides from the official-portal list in its card (eligible_nationalities, 97 entries, retrieved 2026-10-19; instrument Kepmenkumham M.HH-02.GR.01.06 Tahun 2024, ditetapkan 2024-01-09, from a secondary source, annex identity with the portal list TO_VERIFY), separate from the page verbatim. The nationality answer is an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code; an unknown code is asked again; a known unlisted code is NOT_COVERED. A1-eligible nationals on this list remain B1-eligible.

Temporary/emergency passports are explicitly allowed. Stateless persons and other listed non-national documents are excluded. Passport validity, photographs, tickets and payment remain the Law checklist.
Both pages say no sponsor. B4 has no exact price key and is_sold stays null. B1 links only its exact initial and extension keys; PNBP is reference only.
The pages mention conversion through bridging, not an express ITAP entitlement. DB itap and apply_channel stay null; e-VOA validity of 90 days is not a stay option.
